notice: All photographs are AI-generated synthetic images of a fictional, unbadged vehicle. They do not depict a real vehicle, person, location, license plate or incident.

generation.method: AI image generation (GitHub Copilot image_generation tool)
generation.promptRecord: The prompt fields below are faithful summaries of the prompts supplied to the image tool; the verbatim prompt text was not retained for this claim. Source hashes are exact.
generation.consistencyApproach: Photograph 1 was generated from text only; photographs 2-4 were generated with photograph 1 supplied as a visual reference so the same vehicle, paint, wheels, damage and setting carry across the set.
generation.importProcess: build_evidence.py --import-photos converts each source PNG to a baseline JPEG (quality 88, 4:2:0 subsampling) with no EXIF or other embedded metadata. Pixels and dimensions are unchanged.
generation.manualReview: Each image was inspected visually before import: the same black unbadged three-row SUV at a wet residential curb on an overcast day, with the same right side sideswipe damage (red transfer on the right doors, hanging right mirror, gouged right front wheel) in every view that shows the right side; no people, no readable text, blank plates, no annotations or overlays.
